items.t: Lower intake manifold gasket leaks coolant
items.job: Replace lower intake manifold gaskets and flush coolant
items.note: If coolant reached the oil, add an oil change and check for bearing damage.

items.t: Oil leaking onto exhaust manifold can start a fire (recall)
items.job: Inspect, reseal and add shields per recall (08V-118, 09V-116, 15V-201, 15V-701)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Automatic transmission slips or fails
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with a remanufactured unit
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $2,500 on average.

items.t: Car stalls or will not start and dash lights flicker
items.job: Replace ignition switch or repair wiring connections
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $300 on average.

items.t: Engine stalls from a failing crankshaft or airflow sensor
items.job: Replace crankshaft position sensor or mass airflow sensor

items.t: Key stuck in the ignition from a failed shifter part
items.job: Repair shifter park lock interlock

items.t: Power windows stop working
items.job: Replace power window regulator and motor
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $700 on average, often at a dealer.

items.t: Steering can become very heavy in turns (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair steering gear bearing (recall 03V-527)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Brake line can wear through (recall)
items.job: Inspect and reposition or replace brake line (recall 96V-069)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Engine may not start and could catch fire (recall)
items.job: Recall repair (96V-116)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Windshield wipers can stop working (recall)
items.job: Recall repair of wiper system (99V-348)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: ABS motor short can cause an underhood fire (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair ABS motor and brake pipe (recall 99V-170)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Seat belt buckle may not hold in a crash (recall)
items.job: Replace seat belt buckles (recall 00V-228)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Excessive oil consumption (2.4L)
items.job: Replace pistons and rings
items.note: One owner was quoted about $3,200 for piston replacement. GM may have covered this under special coverage; ask a dealer with your VIN.

items.t: Timing chain stretch and rattle
items.job: Replace timing chain, guides and tensioner
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $2,000 on average.

items.t: Engine stalls or loses power while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling and replace failed sensor or solenoid
items.note: If the timing chain is the cause, see that repair instead.

items.t: Transmission will not engage
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with a remanufactured unit
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $2,000 on average; a valve body or solenoid repair can cost less.

items.t: Front seat wiring can short and cause a fire (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair front seat harness (recall 16V-517)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Key can be removed when not in Park (recall)
items.job: Recall repair of ignition key interlock (16V-502)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Front turn signal can be partly dark (recall)
items.job: Reprogram body control module (recall 12V-484)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: eAssist charging system can overheat (recall)
items.job: Test and replace eAssist generator control module (recall 13V-173)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Rear toe links can rust and break (recall)
items.job: Replace both rear toe links and align (recall 20V-764)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Piston damage from low-speed pre-ignition (2.0L turbo)
items.job: Replace damaged piston(s) or engine
items.note: A cracked piston often means a replacement engine, which costs far more.

items.t: Power steering assist cuts out with Service Power Steering message
items.job: Repair ground and reprogram power steering module
items.note: If the steering motor or gear has failed, replacement costs much more.

items.t: Hard start or black smoke after sitting
items.job: Diagnose and perform GM hard-start bulletin repair

items.t: Reduced power from a failing high-pressure fuel pump
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump

items.t: Oil leak at the engine front cover
items.job: Reseal engine front cover

items.t: Brake pedal can stick down
items.job: Replace brake pedal arm

items.t: Rear brake caliper pistons can corrode (recall)
items.job: Replace rear brake calipers (recall 18V-576)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Rear seat belts may not hold in a crash (recall)
items.job: Recall repair of rear outboard seat belts (18V-230)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Power brake assist can be lost (recall)
items.job: Recall repair for power brake assist (22V-465)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Hard brake pedal or hissing from oil in the brake booster
items.job: Replace brake booster and fix oil source per bulletin

items.t: Water pump noise or coolant leak
items.job: Replace water pump and coolant

items.t: Fuel in the oil
items.job: Oil change, replace PCV valve and update engine computer

items.t: Sticky or notchy steering feel near center
items.job: Perform GM steering bulletin repair or software update
